subject: Variance parameter for nonlinear effect- Zambia example

messages.author: f0c082e20614d8f1
messages.subject: Variance parameter for nonlinear effect- Zambia example
parts:
Apologies if my question is too simple. I was trying to follow the Zambian example under the case studies were the effect of age was considered as nonlinear (mod3). I also ran the code below to obtain the posterior mean and standard deviation of variance parameter for variable agc. How would I interpret such variance parameter if it is meaningful? I could not find it in the paper.

 

> prec.marg = mod3$marginals.hyperpar$"Precision for agc"

> m1 = inla.expectation(function(x) 1/x, prec.marg)

> m2 = inla.expectation(function(x) (1/x)^2, prec.marg)

> sd = sqrt(m2 - m1^2)

> print(c(mean=m1, sd=sd))

        mean           sd

1.184533e-04 9.011286e-05
